title: IRS Form Intimacy
outcome: Know which IRS forms exist in sensitive ranges, where official PDFs live, and which fill strategies are institutional versus contested.
source_notebooks: The Unconfused Man and his Person

steps.title: Use IRS.gov as the catalog of record

lines.text: Prefer current forms and instructions published at IRS.gov; note the revision date on every download.

speed_bumps: Third-party reprints and out-of-date software packages may omit sparse or infrequently used forms.

steps.title: Map 8xxx-range sensitivity

forms.title: Form 8300 — Report of Cash Payments Over $10,000

lines.text: Many Form 8xxx series items are information, fiduciary, foreign, or election forms that consumer tax software underserves; treat sparse and sensitive bands as requiring the official instructions.

speed_bumps: Form availability and filing thresholds change; always check the current instructions for who must file and where.

steps.title: Form 8822-B — official purpose

forms.title: Form 8822-B — Change of Address or Responsible Party — Business

lines.text: Use Form 8822-B to notify the IRS of a business address change or a change in the responsible party, following the current form instructions and mailing address.

speed_bumps: Responsible-party rules and where to file depend on the entity type and the reason for the change; read the instructions before mailing.

delivery.method: Mail or electronic path stated in current Form 8822-B instructions
delivery.destination: IRS address listed for the applicable box on the form

steps.title: Inventory contested 8822-B fill strategies separately

forms.title: Form 8822-B — Change of Address or Responsible Party — Business

lines.text: Fills that rename the responsible party to a Treasury office or relocate the business domicile to a Treasury street address as a jurisdictional strategy are contested and are not the default institutional use of Form 8822-B.

speed_bumps: Official instructions describe address and responsible-party changes for the business; they do not authorize unverified relocation theories.
flags: Contested — inventory with caveats; not settled procedure.
Do not treat contested responsible-party fills as the recommended playbook.

steps.title: Know IRM frivolous and fictitious-instrument screens

lines.text: IRS internal materials describe screening for frivolous returns and fictitious obligations; those screens are reasons for flags, not targets to game.

evidence_hooks.ref: IRM 25.25.10 Frivolous Return Program (confirm current citation)

speed_bumps: Penalties and enforcement paths attach to frivolous positions and fictitious instruments.
flags: IRM frivolous / fictitious-instrument screens — inventory only, not a recommended playbook.
